_header: Diego Venegas-Vargas | DAMIC-M collaboration | CCDarkSens Framework -- Example input for utils/darkphoton_generate_grid.py: generates dark-photon-absorption dR/dE rate CSVs for real Si, used by both absorption_si_lbc_1p3kgday.json and (subset, mA'<=50 eV) absorption_si_projection_1kgyear.json.
_comment: Dark-photon absorption rate generation: Si target, band_gap_eV=null lets darkphoton_generate_grid.py use Si's native gap. 200 masses (1-100 eV log) x 40 couplings (eps=1e-20..1e-10 log) = 8000 files. Run: python3 utils/darkphoton_generate_grid.py configs/examples/darkphoton_generate_si_lbc_full.json
